title: Hygiene Limited Water
description: Prioritizes what to clean when water is short (hands, face, groin and armpits, feet) and explains water-efficient and no-water body washing and hair care. Covers dental care, feminine hygiene, wound and skin care, toilet hygiene, laundry, a hygiene kit, and a daily routine.
shortDescription: Sponge baths, no-water cleaning, dental and feminine care, and laundry
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
